方芸别过脸，耳朵尖红透了。

“看什么看。”

“这丝袜……也太涩了。”

许默收回目光，脸红，但脸皮也厚。

“属性确实加了。”

“你自己看面板。”

方芸低头扫了一眼，轻啊了一声：“防御力涨了一大截……这丝袜还真有用。”

许默把钱袋子的事简单说了一遍。

“那当然。”

“昨晚那个流浪商人，刷新了十次。头六次全是垃圾——绷带、木矛、发霉面包什么的。后四次出了好东西。”

他掰着手指头数：“紫色战斧图纸，攻击力加九十，但卖一千八，我买不起。蓝色望远镜，一百，能看五公里。蓝色胸甲，一百九，就你身上这件。绿色丝袜图纸，一百。”

方芸皱眉：“你花了多少？”

“加上后续黑市买配方和材料，总共将近五千幸存值。”

“别急，我没瞎花钱。”

他把再生药水配方等好东西一样样亮出来：“这些东西加起来，够我们做恢复药剂。以后受伤不用干扛着了。”

方芸没说话，走过来，抬手摸了摸他手臂上那道伤疤。

经过一夜休息，伤口已经结痂，但周围皮肤还是红肿的。

“你的伤好些了没？”

许默活动了一下肩膀。

“好多了。”“不碍事。”

方芸点了点头，没再追问。

她抱着手臂，目光落向洞外那片灰白色的石林。

似乎是感受到了那边神秘的存在，她微微皱起眉头。

许默清了清嗓子，把传送阵的事说了出来。

“你感觉到了吧，石林深处有座古塔，里面是个运转中的传送阵。但周围守着二十多只石像鬼，会飞，魔免，攻高血厚。我打算等准备周全了，去闯一趟。”

方芸转头看他，眼里没有犹豫。

“好，我们去。”

“但你得答应我，不是现在出发。先把药做出来，把该升的装备升上去，把那些人手和组织都理清楚了，再动手。”

许默笑了：“我也是这么想的。”

他站起来，拍了拍身上的灰，把手伸给方芸。

Fang Yun turned away, the tips of her ears turned red.

"What are you looking at?"

"These stockings...are too astringent."

Xu Mo looked away, blushing, but also thick-skinned.

"The attributes have really improved."

"Look at the panel yourself."

Fang Yun glanced down and said softly: "The defense has increased a lot...these stockings are really useful."

Xu Mo briefly talked about the money bag.

"Of course."

"The wandering merchant refreshed ten times last night. The first six times were full of garbage - bandages, wooden spears, moldy bread and so on. The last four times brought out good things."

He counted on his fingers: "The purple battle ax blueprint increases the attack power by ninety, but it costs one thousand and eighty, and I can't afford it. The blue telescope, one hundred, can see five kilometers. The blue breastplate, one hundred and ninety, is the one you are wearing. The green stockings blueprint, one hundred."

Fang Yun frowned: "How much did you spend?"

"Including the subsequent purchase of formulas and materials on the black market, the total survival value is nearly 5,000."

"Don't worry, I didn't spend money blindly."

He showed off the regeneration potion formula and other good things: "Together, these things are enough for us to make a recovery potion. We don't have to carry it around when we get injured in the future."

Fang Yun said nothing, walked over, raised her hand and touched the scar on his arm.

After a night's rest, the wound had scabbed over, but the surrounding skin was still red and swollen.

"Is your injury feeling better?"

Xu Mo moved his shoulders.

"Much better." "It's not a problem."

Fang Yun nodded and didn't ask any more questions.

She crossed her arms and looked towards the gray-white stone forest outside the cave.

She frowned slightly as if she felt the mysterious presence over there.

Xu Mo cleared his throat and told him about the teleportation array.

"You feel it, right? There is an ancient tower deep in the stone forest, and inside it is a running teleportation array. But there are more than twenty gargoyles guarding it. They can fly, are immune to magic, and have high attack and health. I plan to go for it when I am fully prepared."

Fang Yun turned to look at him, with no hesitation in her eyes.

"Okay, let's go."

"But you have to promise me not to set off now. Make the medicine first, upgrade the equipment that needs to be upgraded, and sort out the manpower and organization before we start."

Xu Mo smiled: "I think so too."

He stood up, patted the dust off his body, and extended his hand to Fang Yun.
